hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/guard-write.sh" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/guard-write.sh" ]; then bash "$d/.claude/hooks/guard-write.sh" || exit 2; else echo "BLOCKED: write barrier guard-write.sh not found above ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD} -- ask the coordinator." >&2; exit 2; fi

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/filter-output.sh" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/filter-output.sh" ] && bash "$d/.claude/hooks/filter-output.sh" || echo "{}"

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bash "$d/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh" 2>/dev/null || echo "WARNING: session briefing not found -- ask the coordinator."

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bash "$d/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh" --postcompact 2>/dev/null || echo "WARNING: post-compaction briefing not found -- ask the coordinator."
